__inputs.name: DS_CONIFER_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: Conifer Supabase PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: Select the connected PostgreSQL data source with access to grafana_reporting.

title: Conifer USA — GTM Command Center
description: Conifer USA outbound intelligence from the five Supabase reporting views. Contact details are excluded.

list.name: company
list.label: Company
list.definition: select c.name || ' · ' || coalesce(c.domain,c.id::text) as __text,c.id::text as __value from grafana_reporting.company_scores c order by 1
list.query: select c.name || ' · ' || coalesce(c.domain,c.id::text) as __text,c.id::text as __value from grafana_reporting.company_scores c order by 1

list.name: tier
list.label: Priority tier
list.definition: select distinct c.priority_tier from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where nullif(c.priority_tier,'') is not null order by 1
list.query: select distinct c.priority_tier from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where nullif(c.priority_tier,'') is not null order by 1

list.name: category
list.label: Signal category
list.definition: select distinct btrim(part.label) as category from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s cross join lateral unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) as part(label) where btrim(part.label) <> '' order by 1
list.query: select distinct btrim(part.label) as category from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s cross join lateral unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) as part(label) where btrim(part.label) <> '' order by 1

list.name: campaign
list.label: Campaign
list.definition: select k.name as __text,k.id::text as __value from grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k order by 1
list.query: select k.name as __text,k.id::text as __value from grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k order by 1

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring}))

select coalesce(sum(t.contacts),0) from grafana_reporting.company_scores c left join grafana_reporting.contact_counts t on t.company_id=c.id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Total buying signals
panels.description: Company, tier and signal-category filters apply. Includes undated signals.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s join grafana_reporting.company_scores c on c.id=s.company_id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${category:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) AS part(label) WHERE btrim(part.label) IN (${category:sqlstring})))
select count(*) from grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k where ('__all' IN (${campaign:sqlstring}) OR k.id::text IN (${campaign:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Average ICP score
panels.description: Average across scored companies in the selection.

targets.rawSql: select round(avg(c.icp_score),1) from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring}))

panels.title: ICP score distribution
panels.description: Scored companies grouped by ICP score bands.

targets.rawSql: select case when c.icp_score <60 then 'Below 60' when c.icp_score <80 then '60–79' else '80–100' end as "ICP score", count(*) as "Companies" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and c.icp_score is not null group by 1 order by min(c.icp_score)

select coalesce(c.priority_tier,'Unrecorded') as "Tier", count(*) as "Companies" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) group by 1 order by 1

select coalesce(c.qualification_status,'Unrecorded') as "Status", count(*) as "Companies" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Top companies ranked by ICP score

targets.rawSql: select c.name as "Company", c.domain as "Domain", c.icp_score as "ICP score", c.priority_tier as "Tier", c.qualification_status as "Qualification", c.industry as "Industry", c.headquarters_country as "HQ country", c.employee_count as "Employees" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and c.icp_score is not null order by c.icp_score desc,c.name,c.id limit 25

panels.title: Signals by category
panels.description: Counts each distinct saved category once per signal. A signal can belong to multiple categories.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(labels.category,'Unrecorded') as "Category", count(*) as "Signals" from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s join grafana_reporting.company_scores c on c.id=s.company_id left join lateral (select distinct btrim(part.label) as category from unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) as part(label) where btrim(part.label) <> '') labels on true where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${category:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) AS part(label) WHERE btrim(part.label) IN (${category:sqlstring}))) and ('__all' IN (${category:sqlstring}) OR labels.category IN (${category:sqlstring})) group by 1 order by 2 desc,1

select c.name as "Company", count(*) as "Signals" from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s join grafana_reporting.company_scores c on c.id=s.company_id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${category:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) AS part(label) WHERE btrim(part.label) IN (${category:sqlstring}))) group by c.id,c.name order by 2 desc,1 limit 10

panels.title: Recent buying signals
panels.description: Uses the observation date when available and the database record date otherwise. The Observed and Recorded columns show both dates separately.

targets.rawSql: select s.observed_at as "Observed", s.created_at as "Recorded", c.name as "Company", s.signal_type as "Category", s.description as "Signal", s.evidence_url as "Evidence URL" from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s join grafana_reporting.company_scores c on c.id=s.company_id cross join lateral (select coalesce(s.observed_at, s.created_at) as effective_date) signal_date where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${category:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) AS part(label) WHERE btrim(part.label) IN (${category:sqlstring}))) and $__timeFilter(signal_date.effective_date) order by coalesce(s.observed_at, s.created_at) desc,s.id limit 25

panels.title: Signal evidence and confidence
panels.description: Includes undated signals. Confidence comes directly from the reporting view.

targets.rawSql: select c.name as "Company", s.signal_type as "Category", s.description as "Evidence", coalesce(nullif(btrim(s.evidence_confidence),''),'Unrecorded') as "Confidence", s.evidence_url as "Evidence URL", s.observed_at as "Observed" from grafana_reporting.buying_signals s join grafana_reporting.company_scores c on c.id=s.company_id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${category:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(s.signal_type, ';')) AS part(label) WHERE btrim(part.label) IN (${category:sqlstring}))) order by s.observed_at desc nulls last,c.name,s.id

select c.name as "Company", c.domain as "Domain", coalesce(t.contacts,0) as "Contacts", coalesce(t.verified_emails,0) as "Verified emails" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c left join grafana_reporting.contact_counts t on t.company_id=c.id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) order by 3 desc,c.name

panels.title: Verified email counts
panels.description: Uses the reporting view's verification definition.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(t.verified_emails),0) as "Verified emails" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c left join grafana_reporting.contact_counts t on t.company_id=c.id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring}))

select c.name as "Company", c.domain as "Domain", c.icp_score as "ICP score", c.priority_tier as "Tier" from grafana_reporting.company_scores c left join grafana_reporting.contact_counts t on t.company_id=c.id where ('__all' IN (${company:sqlstring}) OR c.id::text IN (${company:sqlstring})) and ('__all' IN (${tier:sqlstring}) OR c.priority_tier IN (${tier:sqlstring})) and coalesce(t.contacts,0)=0 order by c.icp_score desc nulls last,c.name

panels.title: Campaign overview
panels.description: Record counts are all-time for selected campaigns.

targets.rawSql: select k.name as "Campaign", k.platform as "Platform", k.channel as "Channel", k.status as "Status", k.created_at as "Created", k.recorded_activities as "Recorded activities" from grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k where ('__all' IN (${campaign:sqlstring}) OR k.id::text IN (${campaign:sqlstring})) order by k.created_at desc nulls last,k.id

panels.title: Recorded activity in selected period
panels.description: Counts recorded activity in the selected date range. Zero means no activity was recorded.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(a.activity_count),0) as "Activities" from grafana_reporting.activity_summary a join grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k on k.id=a.campaign_id where ('__all' IN (${campaign:sqlstring}) OR k.id::text IN (${campaign:sqlstring})) and $__timeFilter(a.activity_day)

select coalesce(a.activity_status,'Unrecorded') as "Status", sum(a.activity_count) as "Activities" from grafana_reporting.activity_summary a join grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k on k.id=a.campaign_id where ('__all' IN (${campaign:sqlstring}) OR k.id::text IN (${campaign:sqlstring})) and $__timeFilter(a.activity_day) group by 1 order by 2 desc,1

panels.title: Outreach activity over time
panels.description: Daily recorded activity. Days with no records are left blank.

targets.rawSql: select a.activity_day as "time", sum(a.activity_count)::double precision as "Recorded activities" from grafana_reporting.activity_summary a join grafana_reporting.campaign_summary k on k.id=a.campaign_id where ('__all' IN (${campaign:sqlstring}) OR k.id::text IN (${campaign:sqlstring})) and $__timeFilter(a.activity_day) group by 1 order by 1
